headline: Ben is a marketing swiss army knife.
quote: Ben is a marketing swiss army knife. From content strategy and positioning to design and customer acquisition tactics, he truly understands what it takes to create meaningful user experiences that map to larger company objectives. He's a go-getter, reliable, and a great team driver. If you're lucky enough to work with Ben, you'll quickly notice that he is motivated, humble, and dedicated.
name: Allison Drake
